messages:
laura: ok team — we need to prioritize Console observability work: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. customers (Acme + Beta) pushed this as a must-have for Q2. thoughts on minimum ship and risks?

mike: engineering constraints: tracing hooks require a small SDK change + backend intake adjustments. rough estimate 3w for hook + 1w for backend. dashboards can reuse existing metrics pipeline, much faster. cost breakdown varies: simple per-route aggregation = 1w, token-level lineage = 4w.

jin: SRE note — sampling strategy is key. if we enable full traces by default retention/cost explode. propose: default 5% sampling + 100% traces for error-tagged requests. span metadata we should include: `model`, `route`, `customer_id`, `request_id`. example span tags: `{"model":"vicuna-13b", "route":"/v1/generate", "request_id":"req_123"}`

ash: DevEx asks — can we provide a tiny client hook + example docs? e.g. `redwood.tracing.attach({service:'app', route:'/chat'})`. that will help partners light up tracing quickly. also need a short code sample for web SDK + Node.

sophie: CS — customer asks: (1) per-customer cost breakdown (tokens vs embeddings) exportable CSV, (2) alerting on cost spikes (monthly burn > X), (3) error analytics grouped by root-cause (model, infra, prompt). if we ship only aggregated dashboards, they'll still push for CSV exports.

laura: proposed MVP launch criteria: - dashboards cover top-10 product routes and top-5 cost contributors; - tracing hooks documented + SDK examples; - cost breakdown: per-route + per-customer CSV export; - error analytics: basic grouping and ability to filter by model/route; - regression tests for latency/cost; - 5% canary rollout, monitor for 72h => then 25% => GA.

mike: scope negotiation: agree to drop token-level lineage v1 (move to Q3). include CSV export as MVP (server-side aggregation). we must not send full request payload into traces (PII). propose automatic redaction for `input_text` fields and a flag to enable full traces for Private deployments.

jin: adding to that — Private deployments will need KMS/HSM handling for trace export and retention policies. suggest `traces.full=true` gated by enterprise config + audit-log. also we should include retention TTLs in the console UI.

ash: i'll prepare dashboard templates (Grafana + Console) with panels: rps, p50/p95 latency, errors by type, cost_per_1k_tokens, top-routes-by-cost. will drop PR with examples and short docs.

laura: action items: - mike: scope plan + timeline (due 1718580000) - ash: SDK hook + docs draft (due 1718540000) - jin: sampling + retention runbook + security notes (due 1718560000) - ash/sophie: CSV export UX proposal (due 1718555000) - triage-bot: create tracking epic. :eyes:

triage-bot: created epic RINF-5123 (observability: dashboards + tracing + cost) and linked tickets.

laura: thanks — let's sync Tues 10am to lock prioritization. :thumbsup:
